## Grammar.wrap() method

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

Quote an identifier so reserved words and mixed case are safe.

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
abstract wrap(identifier: string): string;
```

## Remarks

Escapes any embedded quote character by doubling it. Identifiers are quoted, never validated — do not build one from user input.
